evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('Every new hire completes') enacts authority-ranking: a requirement imposed uniformly on all newcomers, not a reciprocal or market exchange.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Stating that the checklist superseded a prior system reports an authority-ranking move — one directive replacing another — but the relational signal is weak and propositional.
